description: Welcome to Maison Marie, A fully renovated prestigious residence, located in La Varenne Saint-Hilaire, just 30 minutes from Paris. This manor house combines 18th century charm and modern comfort: 10 elegant bedrooms, heated swimming pool, movie room, billiards, bar, equipped kitchen, wooded garden and independent annex. Ideal for stays with family, friends or colleagues, in a refined, warm, exotic and rejuvenating setting.The spaceThe house is spread over several levels and offers: • 10 tastefully decorated double bedrooms, each with its own bathroom • A large bright living room, a friendly dining room, and a fully equipped kitchen • A private bar, billiards area, movie theater, and gym • A fenced garden with heated pool, terrace, garden furniture, and children's playground • An independent annex for more privacy or group meetingsEach room has been designed to offer comfort, privacy and functionality, whether you are coming for a weekend or a long stay.Guest accessYou have exclusive access to the entire property: main house, garden, pool, annexes, gym and cinema. Each stay begins with a personalized welcome, during which we introduce you to the house, its amenities and answer any questions you may have. Private parking is available on site. Easily check yourself in with a secure key or code system.Other things to note• Parties prohibited – Maison Marie is a place of peace and quiet• Heated swimming pool open from May to September• Children welcome, baby cot and high chair available• Pets allowed under certain conditions (upon prior request)• Not accessible for people with reduced mobility (stairs)
